scope: Abstract setwise finite-dependent site field; not a Bernoulli critical counterexample
reproduction: Common-anchor minimum on the union of 2d+1 windows has probability |intersection|/|union|=(2L-1)^d/[(2L+1)^(d-1)(2L+1+2d)]. Adjacent good sites share one anchor and remain in its L-box.
remaining_gap: No FKG, monotonicity, or compatible critical bond blocks.

scope: Sufficient criterion under full setwise range-r independence
reproduction: K=(r+1)^2 color classes in a coordinate plane give all-bad probability <=delta^(m/K); the enclosing bad star-circuit sum is <=8/49 when delta<=64^-K. Origin-good probability is >=1-delta.
remaining_gap: No reason critical block events satisfy this quantitative premise.

scope: Any fixed event determined by M distinct iid Bernoulli bits
reproduction: A uniform-label coupling changes some input bit with probability 1-(1-|p-p'|)^M; an event can change only then.
At p'=p_c-min(p_c/2,(delta_star-delta)/(2M)), the bad marginal is <=delta+M(p_c-p')<delta_star. L2 and deterministic compatibility contradict p'<p_c.
remaining_gap: Finite compatible blocks with the strict actual error/range bound are unconstructed.

scope: Correction to a live card's endpoint application, not to Burton-Keane's theorem

scope: Abstract family counterexample to interchanging limits
reproduction: For f_n(p)=0.5exp(-(p_*-p)n), fixed p<p_* gives limit 0 while f_n(p_*)=0.5; every finite-n function is continuous and monotone as stated.

scope: Polynomial critical one-arm lower bound for nearest-neighbour bond percolation on Z^d
reproduction: Duminil-Copin--Tassion's finite-set threshold forces phi_pc(Lambda_n)>=1. Its 2d(2n+1)^(d-1) boundary summands are each <=p_c*a_n(pc). Uniform subcritical exponential decay would pass by finite-event continuity and contradict this lower bound.

scope: Setwise range-r site-field sufficient criterion only
reproduction: Whole-good tiles of side r+1 have bad probability <=(r+1)^2 delta and setwise range one, since coarse distance >=2 gives physical distance >=r+2. Apply w429 L2 with r=1 and connect adjacent full tiles.
remaining_gap: No compatible critical blocks with delta*(r+1)^2<64^-4.

scope: Obstruction to using arXiv:2304.12110 Theorem 2 at p_c
reproduction: m_h(p)=E_p[1-exp(-h|C(0)|)] decreases to theta(p) as h decreases to zero, with infinite clusters contributing one. Thus q_h=p_c(1-m_h(pc)) tends to p_c(1-theta(pc)).
remaining_gap: Comparison at q_h cannot supply a critical endpoint when theta(pc)>0; e^-hn degenerates as h decreases.
